install.whyRemovedIsZero: The new mogrt.txt lists the same ten filenames. install.ps1 only deletes a previous name that is absent from the new list, so N is 0. Local Templates still has those ten files once each, plus Adobe Basic Lower Third and Basic Title. No brand duplicates.

bugs: npm test's new installer tests fail on this PC: no bash, and Windows file mode is 0o666 rather than 0o755.
icacls Users Modify runs only the first time C:\ProgramData\CloudRuBrandKit is created. An existing folder keeps the inherited ReadAndExecute plus Write, not (OI)(CI)(M).

The JSON polyfill in brandkit.jsx installs only when JSON.stringify is missing. On After Effects 26.5, stringify of a string that contains '-' throws, so a project path like panel-live makes the panel show «Нет композиции» and «AE —». Premiere 26.5.2 on a fresh engine returned the sequence and the host version without that override.
install.cmd with no arguments always pauses. That is the double-click behaviour. The recorded runs fed nul.
The OK line uses backslashes and appends «, 1.0 MB». Count, signed, and the date match the handoff.
Sandbox -WithAme does not copy presets: the sandbox has no Adobe Media Encoder version folder. The script says so.
The status line concatenates the font sentence directly onto the host version.

Opening the scratch prproj as a Premiere command-line argument has produced «This file path does not exist on disk at this location» for C:\CRBK\work\panel-live\pr\panel_live.prproj while the file was on disk. Opening it through the shell association, with Premiere already running and no path argument, opened the project (17 sequences).
